title: pluchea somaliensis
intro: Pluchea somaliensis, commonly known as Somali pluchea, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pluchea somaliensis include wound healing, anti-diarrheal effects, and treatment of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its various medicinal properties.
